name: flowpane
description: Live side panel showing the flow, todos and decisions of the current Claude Code conversation

autoOpen.title: Open at startup
autoOpen.description: Open the Flowpane pane when a session starts (seats from 144 terminal columns)

decisionTool.title: Decision tool
decisionTool.description: Give the model a RecordDecision tool and ask it to log choices between approaches

inferDecisions.title: Infer decisions
inferDecisions.description: When a turn logged no decision, ask the small fast model to extract one from the answer (costs model calls)

minimap.title: Minimap
minimap.description: Show a one-row minimap of every tool call in the terminal

maxNodes.title: Max flow nodes
maxNodes.description: Older turns collapse to a summary past this many nodes
